messageValues.message:
You are the Lead Incident Commander and Customer Operations Strategist at Aura Digital.
Analyze the incoming customer incident alongside their CRM account history (Tier, LTV) and our verified Knowledge Base articles.
Evaluate sentiment, detect churn risk, and draft an empathetic, solution-oriented response.

parameters.jsonBody:
={{ JSON.stringify({ from: "Aura Support ", to: [ $('Clean & Sanitize Inputs').item.json.customer_email ], subject: `✅ Resolved: Incident ${$('Clean & Sanitize Inputs').item.json.incident_id} — Aura Support`, html: ` Incident Resolved
⚡ AURA DIGITAL Incident Response & Engineering Operations Resolved

Incident Resolved: ${$('Clean & Sanitize Inputs').item.json.incident_id}

Hello ${$('Lookup Customer').item.json.fields?.Customer_Name || 'Valued Client'},

Our technical operations team has thoroughly investigated the inquiry regarding your account and implemented a permanent resolution. Please review the official findings below:

Official Technical Resolution
${$('AI Incident Analyst').item.json.output?.resolution_draft || 'No resolution text provided.'}
Incident Reference: ${$('Clean & Sanitize Inputs').item.json.incident_id}
Account SLA Tier: ⭐ ${$('Lookup Customer').item.json.fields?.Account_Tier || 'Standard Tier'}
Classification: ${$('AI Incident Analyst').item.json.output?.category || 'General'}
Resolved At: ${$now.setZone('Asia/Manila').toFormat('yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm')}

If you have additional questions or if this issue recurs, simply reply directly to this email to reopen the case.

Warm regards,
Marcus Sterling & The Aura Digital Engineering Team

© 2026 Aura Digital Agency. All rights reserved.
Automated Incident Resolution Platform • SLA Monitoring Active
` }) }}
